# White Tab Partners LLP
> A full-service Indian law firm with offices in New Delhi and Dubai.

White Tab Partners LLP is an Indian law firm practising in litigation, arbitration, corporate advisory, and cross-border matters. The firm appears before the Supreme Court of India, the Delhi High Court, the NCLT, NCLAT, DRT, and other Indian courts and tribunals. Members of the firm hold senior counsel appointments for the Government of India.

## Partners

- **Randeep Sachdeva** – Managing Partner. Senior Panel Counsel for the Government of India. Formerly with the Enforcement Directorate and the Office of the Additional Solicitor General of India. Appeared before 7-Judge and 9-Judge Constitution Benches of the Supreme Court.
- **Prashant Sodhi** – Managing Partner. Specialises in white-collar crime, criminal trials, and high-value financial disputes before High Courts and District Courts.
- **Tanpreet Singh Kohli** – Of Counsel (CA & Advocate). Dual-qualified Chartered Accountant and Advocate specialising in tax advisory, international taxation, and forensic financial practice.

## Practice Areas

- Dispute Resolution: Civil & Commercial Litigation, Arbitration, White Collar Crime, Negotiable Instruments, Matrimonial Law
- Corporate: M&A, Private Equity, Corporate Governance, Real Estate, Taxation
- Finance: Insolvency & Bankruptcy (NCLT/NCLAT), Banking & Finance, Recovery of Dues, DRT
- Markets: Capital Markets, Securities Regulatory Advisory, Cross-Border Matters
- International Desk: India-UAE legal services, Dubai Golden Visa, Croatian residency, Cross-border dispute resolution
